note: Original factual paraphrases; source photographs and full articles are not reproduced. A primary source is evidence only within its stated scope. Indexed full text is distinguished from a successful direct fetch.

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1155, s. 1998
sources.publisher: President of the Philippines; text reproduced by Lawphil
sources.evidence: Designates Lake Danao and its surroundings as a natural park; the description follows named creeks and rivers.
sources.limits: 1998 protected-area extent, not a surveyed visitor area or current permission. Subject to prior private rights and actual ground survey.

sources.title: Basic Morphology and Morphometry of Lake Danao in Ormoc City, Leyte, the Philippines
sources.publisher: John O. de la Cruz et al.; Philippine Journal of Science 153(2), 693–702
sources.locator: pp. 694–695 and Appendix I, p. 698; Figs. 1–2
sources.evidence: July 2022 fieldwork by UP researchers; zigzag sonar survey and connected lake basins.
sources.limits: Full indexed paper inspected; fresh direct fetch returned 403. No measurement, geological hypothesis or water-quality statement is generalized into current visitor guidance.

sources.title: Contribution to the Bazzania flora of the Philippines. 1. Bazzania subtilis and similar species
sources.publisher: Uwe Schwarz, Alfons Schäfer-Verwimp and James R. Shevock; Frahmia 33

sources.evidence: 2000 collection near Kasudsuran, bark substrate, species description and dry-leaf etymology; only the type collection was known at publication.
sources.limits: Full indexed paper inspected; direct tool fetch exceeded its size limit. Not a present population survey, endemic-range proof, visitor route or identification of a bundled photograph. Specimen barangay label differs from locally confirmed visitor routing.

sources.title: Pictures of selected Bazzania species — Bazzania globuliformis
sources.evidence: Confirms collectors, date, bark habitat and specimen identity.
sources.limits: No photos copied or reuse licence inferred; exact collection coordinates are not visitor-access evidence.

sources.title: Save Lake Janagdan
sources.locator: Issue, objectives, starter and creation date
sources.evidence: Campaigners requested rerouting for farmers without cutting through forest, citing Cabintan’s water-source concern.
sources.limits: Evidence of what petitioners said, not independent proof of hydrology, geology, hazard classification, success or current rules. Day varies by rendering/time zone; panel uses month.

sources.title: 2018 RDC VIII Resolutions, Resolution 89
sources.publisher: Regional Development Council VIII; current DEPDev Region VIII official archive
sources.evidence: Endorses realignment of Janagdan access-road funding to other destination access roads.
sources.limits: Official indexed text inspected; direct request returned 403. Register title is not proof of transfer, spending, completed works or causal effect of the petition. Signed resolution not obtained.

sources.title: 2018 fourth-quarter physical accomplishment report
sources.locator: Wetlands Conservation and Management Program, item 3.4
sources.evidence: Lists Janagdan among wetland assessments and management plans reviewed.
sources.limits: Full indexed report inspected after direct 403. Review is not adoption, an approved map or evidence of current conditions.

sources.title: State of the Mangrove in Ormoc City
sources.publisher: Rafael Junnar P. Dumalan, Ormoc LGU; State of the Mangrove Summit: Central and Eastern Visayas Proceedings
sources.type: City environmental officer’s primary historical assessment
sources.evidence: 2000 community forestry agreement; typhoon destruction; 2014 clearing/nursery work; 2017 ecotourism initiative.
sources.limits: Historical management landscape, not the present visitor footprint. Early planting dates differ across records; no exact park opening date is asserted.

sources.title: Comparative Evaluation of the S&T-Based Mangrove Rehabilitation and Community-Based Eco-Tourism Management Practices… (Paraiso and Naungan–San Juan)
sources.publisher: Jean Gay Octaviano-Ragub; University of the Philippines Open University repository
sources.type: Original academic field study and interviews
sources.locator: Naungan–San Juan site description and interview findings; title abbreviated
sources.evidence: Connects the association’s restoration work with the Naungan eco-park.
sources.limits: Some retrospective dates differ from the city officer’s chronology. Its old activity list is not current authorization. The adjacent Paraiso site discussed in this paper is not ARgala D04.

sources.title: Natural Resource Management Strategies on Leyte Island
sources.publisher: A. Groetschel et al.; Humboldt University, Baybay/Berlin
sources.evidence: Describes pineapple and sugarcane cultivation at large scale around Ormoc.
sources.limits: Regional context only; does not identify Sal’s particular Biliboy parcel, its cultivar, owner or founding.

sources.title: Festival Champs
sources.date: Reports the event of 2017-06-25; page undated
sources.evidence: First Piña Festival, June 25 2017; harvest celebration; STI Ormoc street-dance and showdown results.
sources.limits: A participant’s account of its own wins, not a plantation history. No annual schedule or current event is inferred.

sources.title: 8th Tri-District Convention at Ormoc City
sources.publisher: J. Flor R. Nicolas; The Cabletow, Grand Lodge of the Philippines
sources.evidence: Three Masonic districts’ convention and sports committee golf competitions at Leyte Golf and Country Club.
sources.limits: Establishes use by 1994, not founding. The historical Macabug label does not replace present catalog routing.

sources.title: Leyte Golf

sources.locator: Opening section before the first divider
sources.evidence: Recalls invitations from Nonoy Tan, Cebu fast-ferry day trips, golf and hospitality.
sources.limits: Not current transport or admission advice. A later paragraph’s tournament is in Cebu, not this club.

sources.title: Application of the United Nations Framework Classification to Geothermal Energy Resources: Selected Case Studies
sources.locator: Case Study 7: Alto Peak, printed pp. 39–40
sources.evidence: Three initial exploratory wells drilled in the Alto Peak geothermal area during 1991–1992.
sources.limits: Geothermal sector, not an active summit plant or current trail status. Exact concession geometry and visitor rights are not established.

sources.title: Leyte–Cebu and Leyte–Luzon geothermal projects completion report, Annex 12

sources.limits: Specific historic sector decision, not an assertion that all Leyte geothermal operations stopped or that no future development could occur.

sources.title: Hiking matters #107: The ascent to Alto Peak
sources.evidence: Cabintan-side climb hosted by the Nalda family, old drilling road, forest trail, evening summit and city lights.
sources.limits: Historical experience, not directions or a recommended dusk itinerary. Old transport, food gathering and contacts are excluded.

sources.title: Heavens Peak of Brgy. Cabintan Ormoc City
sources.publisher: Lucia1397; LAAG TA local photo blog
sources.evidence: Records flowers, sunflowers and visitor walks by May 2019.
sources.limits: Publication date is not opening date. Capture dates, authorship of individual pictures and current conditions not established; no images reused.

sources.title: Heaven’s Peak
sources.locator: Flower blocks, walking paths and resting-area narrative
sources.evidence: Dated description of differently colored flower beds, paths and a shaded area.
sources.limits: Visitor observations only. Unnamed owner’s origin story, erroneous map location and approximate area excluded. No images reused.

sources.title: Learning alliance approaches to scaling out vegetable value chains in the southern Philippines — Final Report
sources.publisher: ACIAR; University of Queensland and Visayas State University collaborators
sources.evidence: Cabintan farming and markets in Regions 7 and 8; Heaven’s Peak named among attractions.
sources.limits: Not the garden’s founding history. Does not say the garden grows vegetables or joined the project. Its loose grouping of attractions as peaks is not repeated.

sources.title: About Sabin Resort Hotel
sources.publisher: Sabin Resort Hotel’s self-described official website
sources.evidence: Bamboo-and-nipa huts, hotel concept developed in 1990, two-building expansion in 2006.
sources.limits: Full indexed body inspected; direct fetch timed out. Self-reported history, not independently verified opening date or current ownership/facilities.

sources.title: Faces and shadows in an oft-forgotten place

sources.locator: Sabin hotel veranda and founder’s recollection

sources.limits: Interview recollection, not a title deed or exact opening date. Unrelated political/religious commentary excluded.

sources.publisher: Ormoc City Planning and Development Office; DENR EMB VIII host
sources.locator: Figure 2 zoning and proposed facility figures
sources.evidence: Broad protected/multiple-use zoning and proposed park facilities.
sources.limits: Proposal, not as-built visitor permission. 1:40,000 context is not a safe standing-space survey; no permission to digitize or distribute a derivative activation polygon established.

sources.title: National Integrated Protected Areas System, FeatureServer layer 2
sources.publisher: Service credits DENR BMB and NAMRIA

sources.limits: Protected-area layer, not approved visitor zones. Danao feature export not verified; service access does not by itself establish a reuse licence or survey accuracy. Do not relabel its native CRS as WGS84.

sources.title: Geoportal Philippines Data Inventory
sources.evidence: Distinguishes open, conditional and restricted datasets; tourism layers are leads, not established site polygons.

sources.title: Geoportal Philippines Map Viewer User Manual
sources.evidence: Only listed downloadable layers can be exported; restrictions and terms apply; contact the data owner for other data.
sources.limits: Instructions do not grant a particular data licence or site-entry permission.

sources.limits: Not an operational visitor boundary, present opening notice or permission to reuse third-party basemaps.

sources.publisher: Premiumlands Corporation; DENR EMB VIII host
sources.evidence: Proposed works near the Naungan eco-park; shows contextual existing features.
sources.limits: Not proof of completed works, approved public standing space, ownership of all mapped land or derivative geometry rights.

sources.publisher: Ormoc CPDO; third-party copy on Scribd

sources.evidence: Identifies local government offices that can route mapping, site-management and risk inquiries.

sources.title: The GeoJSON Format, RFC 7946
sources.evidence: WGS84 decimal degrees; longitude–latitude position order; Polygon/MultiPolygon rings and closure; coordinate precision does not establish uncertainty.
sources.limits: Survey approval, exclusion choices, safety margins, edge inclusion and entry policy are ARgala requirements, not promises made by GeoJSON.

sources.title: Ormoc tourism map
sources.evidence: A tourism map is published.
sources.limits: No downloadable, manager-approved visitor-area vector surfaced in the accessible response. Not a claim about every possible underlying dataset.

sources.title: ViroSound
sources.locator: source, loop, muted, paused, volume, onError and seekToTime
sources.evidence: WAV and MP3 sources, mono/stereo, loop/pause/mute and relative gain controls.
sources.limits: Docs must be matched to the installed app version by Codex. Mute and pause are not the same as resetting a stale cue; these props do not prove system audio focus is handled.

sources.title: Supported media formats
sources.evidence: Linear PCM/WAVE playback support; hardware sample-rate limits apply.
sources.limits: 48 kHz/16-bit mono is this pack’s delivery choice, not a guarantee of phone-speaker quality or acoustic safety.

sources.title: Manage audio focus
sources.locator: Focus grant/loss and Android version behavior
sources.evidence: Audio focus is separate from volume and app-internal priority; interruption behavior needs deliberate handling.
sources.limits: No application code was inspected or changed; Codex must verify the existing implementation and target SDK.

sources.title: Interaction (UX)
sources.evidence: Avoid simultaneous/conflicting sounds and give users controls.
sources.limits: Cue timbres, durations and digital peak values are our subjective draft design decisions.

sources.title: Safety and comfort
sources.evidence: AR must account for physical surroundings and user comfort.
sources.limits: Does not certify any of ARgala’s locations or substitute for local inspection.

sources.title: Guidance on Applying WCAG 2 to Non-Web ICT (WCAG2ICT)
sources.locator: Equivalent access to information and audio controls
sources.evidence: Provides non-web software guidance for accessible alternatives to audio-only information.
sources.limits: Informative guidance, not a certification or independent app accessibility test.

sources.title: ViroARScene
sources.evidence: Tracking state describes AR pose tracking.
sources.limits: Tracking readiness does not establish GPS arrival, safe surroundings or legal site access.
